author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a pretty serious win when it comes to our privacy. It's been quite an uphill battle but when we cover so much of the negative we should celebrate the positive. Chat control seems to be seriously challenged and our privacy might be on the path to being safer. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We Fought Back And Actually Won!
